### Summary

## Description

The checksum files for uv 0.12.6 appear to be missing from `releases.astral.sh`.

For example, the following URL returns HTTP 404:

`https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.12.6/uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256`

I checked the checksum URLs for the other release variants as well, and they all appear to return 404.

## Expected behavior

The `.sha256` files should be available for each release artifact, as they are for other uv releases.

## Actual behavior

All `.sha256` URLs for the 0.12.6 release return HTTP 404.

For example:

```console
$ curl -I https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.12.6/uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256
HTTP/2 404
```

Could you please check whether the checksum files for the 0.12.6 release were correctly published/mirrored?

### Platform

All platforms

### Version

0.12.6

### Python version

_No response_
title: Checksum files for uv 0.12.6 are missing from releases.astral.sh
